versions.changelog:
Initial release of the AANA Continuous Self-Improvement Skill.

- Introduces a structured self-improvement loop for agents, focused on outcome evaluation and actionable proposals.
- Strong constraints prevent agents from drifting away from user goals, safety boundaries, or approval controls.
- Clearly separates allowed, restricted, and forbidden types of self-improvement.
- Defines AANA-style constraint mapping for physical, human, task, and feedback boundaries.
- Specifies a minimal, privacy-respecting review payload format.
- Outlines concise reporting and approval rules for any agent-led improvements.
